name: established_min_release_groups
note: An artist credited on at least this many counted release groups is established

name: established_counted_primary_types
note: The primary types the established group count reads

name: established_excluded_secondary_types
note: A release group with any of these secondary types never counts toward established

name: established_min_years
note: An artist whose first release of any kind came at least this many calendar years before the cycle day is established

name: emerging_max_release_groups
note: An artist with at most this many release groups of any kind can be emerging

name: emerging_max_years
note: An artist with few release groups whose first release came at most this many calendar years before the cycle day is emerging
